svg.title: F10-2 Isolation sequence of a 20 kV cable feeder panel shown with EN 60617 switch states
svg.text: Open the disconnector or rack the breaker out
Self-test the VDS, then read three phases
indicator I on the earth switch
Lock breaker, disconnector and earth switch
Prove dead at the termination, detector proved before and after
no indication on L1, L2, L3
F10-2 Isolation sequence of a 20 kV cable feeder panel shown with EN 60617 switch states
state A in service · state B breaker open · state C disconnector open (isolated) · state D earth switch closed and locked (safe for work) · VDS check between C and D · locks L-0101, L-0102, L-0103
• The order is breaker, disconnector, VDS check, earth switch, locks, then proving dead at the termination with the MV detector proved before and after.
• In state D all three devices carry a safety lock and a danger tag, and the isolation certificate IC-B1-HV-0112 lists the three lock numbers.
